speaker: Sheldon
text: Someone's in the kitchen, I know. Ho, ho, ho. God sold my soul to the company store.

speaker: Penny
text: Someone's in the kitchen with Dinah. Sheldon. Sheldon. Honey, do you want some coffee? Come on, if you don't stay awake, we'll never finish in time.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm sorry, coffee's out of the question. When I moved to California, I promised my mother that I wouldn't start doing drugs.

speaker: Leonard
text: Someone's in the kitchen with Dinah. Sheldon, we still have 380 of these things to make.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I have complete faith that you will make them.

speaker: Leonard
text: You know, but Sheldon, without your insight and leadership, this entire enterprise will surely fail.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Very well. But if this leads to opiates or hallucinogenics, you're going to have to answer to my mother.
